# Diagnosis fine-tuning (auto-generated by scripts/finetune.py)

Backbone + linear head fine-tuned end-to-end on the planted diagnosis (training subjects, label correlated with site). `reweight` = same, with site x label importance weights (reference for an achievable non-shortcut model). Subject-level balanced accuracy (AUC); mean +/- SD over seeds.
